$comment: WP-S03 seed corpus manifest. Maps each real marketing section to its S3-MEASURED native-coverage thresholds + tolerance bands. These are the regression baseline for the convert.* coverage gate (Contract 14 §6, RESEARCH.md §6.8). Numbers are the REALISTIC band (typed-object props transform/transition/filter/background-gradient routed to fallback per a v1 converter; see WP-S03-findings.md). WP-Q04 moves these sections into packages/shared/fixtures/html/sections/<n>/ with derived expected.coverage.json / expected.a11y.json and copies this manifest to packages/shared/fixtures/html/corpus.manifest.json. The auto-commit floor blocks an auto-commit below `auto_commit_min_native_pct`; below it the convert tool MUST return the dry-run + coverage report and require an explicit `commit` (never auto-persist).

01-pricing-table.notes: Cleanly authored 3-tier pricing grid. CSS grid template, hover transitions, lift transforms, featured-card gradient, check-mark list-style::before pseudo all drive the tail.

02-hero.notes: Two-column gradient hero. Radial+linear gradients (incl. text-clip gradient), glass chip backdrop-filter, button hover transforms/transitions drive the tail.

03-feature-grid.notes: LOWEST-coverage section (heaviest hard-prop density): 6 gradient icon tiles, off-enum font-weight (650), hover transforms/transitions, auto-fit/minmax grid. Anchors the lower end of the band.

04-testimonial.notes:
Quote card with gradient quote-mark (text-clip), grayscale avatar filter, panel gradient. Stripped-text:
and a nested inside figcaption flagged for block-promotion.

05-cta-banner.notes: Full-width gradient CTA with blurred decorative blobs (filter:blur), inline email form (no atomic equiv on free -> e-form Pro / fallback), button hover transform.
